chain_words.nuance: to think something is probably the case, with little evidence
to assume something as a working idea, without firm proof
to hold something to be true, a general and neutral belief
to hold a belief firmly after considering the reasons
to hold a belief with complete confidence and no room for doubt

explanation: These words all express holding a view as true, from a tentative suspicion to complete confidence.

usage_notes.difference: 'Suppose' treats an idea as a working assumption open to revision; 'be certain' expresses full confidence with no room for doubt.
